description: Main Flutter frontend source file implementing a QR code scanner app with camera preview, history, URL handling, and UI theming.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme and home screen.

classes.name: QrHistoryProvider
classes.description: Provides in-memory storage and management for QR scan history.

classes.name: MainScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying camera, scan button, and scan result area.

classes.name: _MainScreenState
classes.description: State management for MainScreen, handling camera control, scan results, and interactions.

classes.name: _AppDrawer
classes.description: Navigation drawer providing options like history, clear history, and about dialog.

classes.name: _QrResultArea
classes.description: Widget showing the scan result with options to copy or open URL.

classes.name: HistoryScreen
classes.description: Displays list of previous scan results stored in memory.

classes.name: Clipboard
classes.description: Helper class to set clipboard data in a cross-platform way.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing the app with a ChangeNotifierProvider for history and MyApp.

methods.name: _launchUrl
methods.description: Attempts to open the scanned value as a URL with validation.

methods.name: _copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies text to system clipboard and shows feedback.

methods.name: _showSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a snack bar message with optional error styling.

methods.name: _onDetect
methods.description: Handles QR code detection, updates state, and stores result.
